arXiv:2607.11875v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 7 月 13 日arXiv:2607.11875v1 [cs.LG] 13 Jul 2026

Transformer 的不变学习动态Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers
在归纳推理任务中in Inductive Reasoning Tasks

Tiberiu Musat
ETH Zurich &Tiago Pimentel
ETH Zurich &Nicholas Zucchet
Stanford &Thomas Hofmann
ETH Zurich Correspondence at tiberiu@musat.ai, tiago.pimentel@inf.ethz.ch
摘要Abstract

我们提出了一个理论框架来解释归纳法的出现 Transformer 语言模型的推理能力。虽然以前的作品 迄今为止，Transformer 的学习动态主要与特定任务相关， 我们研究一类广义的归纳任务，它统一了几种合成任务 文献中已知的任务，包括上下文中的任务We present a theoretical framework to explain the emergence of inductive reasoning abilities in Transformer language models. While previous works on Transformer learning dynamics have so far been mostly tied to specific tasks, we study a generalized class of inductive tasks that unifies several synthetic tasks known in the literature, including in-contextnn- 克和多跳 推理。在本课程中，我们从理论上证明了训练动态 注意力模型可以局限于高度可解释的低维不变量 歧管。在这个流形上，学习动态由少数几个来捕获 可解释的坐标而不是数百万个参数，使得两者 理论和实证分析更容易处理。使用这个框架，我们 描述数据统计如何控制上下文和上下文之间的竞争 在权重学习中，我们研究随机初始化如何确定 当有多种解决方案可能时，“获胜”电路，我们证明了 与流形相关的坐标系可用于自动 检测已在训练模型中学习了哪些电路。通过铸造电路 形成作为一种低维动力学现象，我们朝着 变形金刚如何学习的预测理论。-grams and multi-hop reasoning. In this class, we theoretically prove that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined to a highly interpretable, low-dimensional invariant manifold. On this manifold, the learning dynamics are captured by a handful of interpretable coordinates rather than millions of parameters, making both theoretical and empirical analysis more tractable. Using this framework, we characterize how data statistics govern the competition between in-context and in-weights learning, we study how random initializations determine the ‘winning’ circuit when multiple solutions are possible, and we demonstrate that the coordinate frame associated with the manifold can be used to automatically detect which circuits have been learned in trained models. By casting circuit formation as a low-dimensional dynamical phenomenon, we take a step toward a predictive theory of how Transformers learn.

1 简介Introduction

虽然在理解电路方面已经取得了巨大进展（即 大型语言模型中存在的子网络或权重结构While great progress has been made toward understanding the circuits (i.e. subnetworks, or weight structures) present in large language models[1, 2, 3, 4], 我们还远远没有理解他们背后的学习动态 形成。因此，语言模型中的技能习得基本上仍然是不可预测的, we are still far from understanding the learning dynamics that underlie their formation. As a result, skill acquisition in language models remains mostly unpredictable[5]，这使模型开发变得复杂并导致人工智能 安全问题。更好地了解电路的出现可以降低这些风险，提供 关于如何解释受过训练的内部机制的实际见解 模型，以及帮助设计更好的训练管道, which complicates model development and poses AI safety issues. A better understanding of circuit emergence could reduce these risks, provide practical insights into how to interpret the internal mechanics of trained models, as well as help design better training pipelines[6]。 在这项工作中，我们重点关注负责的电路的出现. In this work, we focus on the emergence of circuits responsible for归纳能力inductive abilities：允许某种语言的通用功能 模型来识别模式、推断规则并执行抽象推理 根据提供的上下文飞行，而不是依赖静态的、记忆的 模式。: general-purpose capabilities that allow a language model to recognize patterns, infer rules, and perform abstract reasoning on the fly based on the provided context, rather than relying on static, memorized patterns.

先前的工作已经从经验和理论上对变压器的感应能力进行了广泛的研究。 然而，归纳能力通常是孤立研究的，仅限于特定任务，例如上下文中Inductive abilities of transformers have been studied extensively by prior work, both empirically and theoretically. However, inductive abilities are typically studied in isolation, limited to specific tasks such as in-contextnn-克-grams[7, 8, 9] or kk跳跃感应-hop induction[10, 11, 12, 13]。 没有统一的理论框架，我们的认识进展缓慢， 三个重要现象仍然特别令人费解。. Without a unifying theoretical framework, our understanding progresses slowly, and three important phenomena remain particularly puzzling. 巡回赛Circuit competition是语言模型训练的一个基本方面is a fundamental aspect of language model training[14, 15, 16]。然而，大多数先前的理论著作都假设是上演的 一次仅训练一个组件，而其他组件保持冻结的学习算法. However, most previous theoretical works assume staged learning algorithms where only one component is trained at a time, while others are kept frozen[17, 18]。一些作品研究了训练期间不同组件的动态相互作用，但仅限于只有一个的小型变压器. A few works study the dynamical interaction of different components during training, but are limited to small transformers with only one[19]或两个or two[20]注意头。attention heads. 数据分布特性Data distributional properties强烈影响情境学习的出现strongly influence the emergence of in-context learning[21, 22, 23]，但机械的理解是 目前仅限于现象学模型, but a mechanistic understanding is currently limited to phenomenological models[24].  随机初始化Randomly initialized网络包含高性能 根据，可以单独训练的子网络networks contain high-performing subnetworks that can be trained in isolation, according to the彩票 票假说lottery ticket hypothesis [25]，但我们目前缺少一个 机械地理解为什么特定的初始化会产生“胜利” 门票。, but we currently lack a mechanistic understanding of why specific initializations yield ‘winning’ tickets.

我们论文的核心贡献是Our paper’s central contribution is the归纳不变流形 推理（IMIR）Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning (IMIR)：一个低维子空间 表现出独立学习动态的参数空间。 参数属于 IMIR 的模型在通过梯度下降更新时将保留在 IMIR 上，这种行为在动力系统理论中称为: a low-dimensional subspace of the parameter space which exhibits self-contained learning dynamics. A model whose parameters belong to the IMIR will remain on the IMIR when updated via gradient descent, a behavior known in dynamical systems theory as an不变流形invariant manifold。 我们从理论上证明了 IMIR 的存在并提供了它的数学描述（. We theoretically prove the existence of the IMIR and provide its mathematical description (section˜3）对于一类广义的归纳任务（) for a generalized class of induction tasks (section˜2）。 重要的是，我们的框架考虑了训练期间模型中所有参数的相互作用，使得研究电路竞争等现象变得更容易。 此外，IMIR 的每个维度都具有高度可解释性，对应于特定变压器组件内的特定基本动作。 这使我们能够找到负责归纳推理能力的变压器电路的简化且可解释的描述。). Importantly, our framework considers all parameter interactions in a model during training, making it more tractable to study phenomena like circuit competition. Moreover, each dimension of the IMIR is highly interpretable, corresponding to a specific elementary action within a specific transformer component. This allows us to find reduced and interpretable descriptions of the transformer circuits responsible for inductive reasoning abilities.

Concretely, we first investigate the circuit competition between in-context learning and in-weights learning (section˜4.2），我们从理论上证明了数据依赖性 情境学习（解决), where we theoretically prove the data dependency of in-context learning (addressing）。其次，我们调查影响 随机初始化对多个上下文学习之间竞争的影响 单个变压器模型内的电路；我们发现获胜电路 由模型的初始化决定，初始化空间区域之间的急剧相变有利于每个电路（部分寻址). Second, we investigate the impact of random initialization on the competition between several in-context learning circuits within a single transformer model; we find that the winning circuit is determined by the model’s initialization, with sharp phase transitions between the regions of initialization space favoring each circuit (partially addressing在这个简化的设置中）。 在in this simplified setup). Insection˜5，我们展示了高度可解释的结构如何 IMIR可用于感应电路的自动检测。最后，在, we show how the highly interpretable structure of the IMIR can be used for automatic detection of inductive circuits. Finally, insection˜6，我们讨论我们的框架的其他可能的应用 以及未来的研究方向。, we discuss other possible applications of our framework and future research directions.

总的来说，我们的工作为理解 感应电路的出现为未来的工作打开了大门 大语言模型的学习动态。Overall, our work provides a theoretical framework for understanding the emergence of inductive circuits and opens the door for future work on the learning dynamics of large language models.

2 一类统一的归纳任务A Unified Class of Inductive Tasks

现有的研究中已经研究了大量的归纳能力 文学A great number of inductive abilities have been studied in the existing literature[26, 10, 7, 3, 11, 27]。 然而，通常会研究模型的归纳能力 这些任务是分开的，这使得很难得出一般结果。我们表明 许多归纳性任务虽然表面上相对不同， 全部共享一些需要在上下文中操作令牌的内在结构 元组。这将使我们能够得出适用于大范围的一般结果 各种任务。 我们在中描述我们的任务类. However, models’ inductive abilities are usually investigated separately across these tasks, which makes it difficult to arrive at general results. We show that many inductive tasks, while being relatively different at the surface level, all share some intrinsic structure requiring in-context manipulation of token tuples. This will enable us to derive general results that apply to a large variety of tasks. We describe our task class insection˜2.1我们给一些 归纳任务的示例。然后，我们描述任务如何依赖于令牌关系和块位置and we give some examples of induction tasks. Then, we describe how the task depends on token relations and block positions insection˜2.2.

2.1 块列表任务类The Block-List Task Class

在自然语言下一个标记预测任务中，大多数单词仅依赖于其上下文的一小部分： 前面的单词块和一些相关块遍布其（可能更大）上下文。 这些相关块可以对应于句子、从句、短语，甚至是诸如连续单词对之类的短跨度。 受到对自然语言依存结构的观察的启发，我们现在 定义一个通用类In natural language next-token prediction tasks, most words depend only on a tiny fraction of their context: the immediately preceding block of words and a few relevant blocks spread throughout its (potentially much larger) context. These relevant blocks may correspond to sentences, clauses, phrases, or even short spans such as consecutive word pairs. 2.2 数据对称性Data Symmetries

在归纳推理任务中，预测通常依赖于高级结构，而不是依赖于标记或绝对位置的任意选择。 我们现在描述数据中存在的一些对称性，这可能会强加这样的结构。In inductive reasoning tasks, predictions typically depend on high-level structure, rather than on arbitrary choices of tokens or absolute positions. We now describe a few symmetries present in our data, which may impose such structure.

令牌对称性。Token Symmetries.

模型在归纳任务中必须学习的是标记之间的关系，而不是任何特定标记的身份。例如，在联想回忆任务中What a model must learn in an inductive task is the relation between tokens, not the identity of any particular token. For instance, in the associative recall task ofsection˜2.1，如果我们始终如一地重新标记词汇表，则“返回先前查询后的标记”规则不会受到影响：实例, the rule “return the token that previously followed the query” is unaffected if we consistently relabel the vocabulary: the instancea​b​…​a→b\mathrm{a\,b}\,\ldots\,\mathrm{a}\rightarrow\mathrm{b}及其重新标记and its relabelingu​v​…​u→v\mathrm{u\,v}\,\ldots\,\mathrm{u}\rightarrow\mathrm{v}通过相同的机制解决。依赖于这种关系结构而不是特定令牌身份的模型恰恰是泛化到训练期间未见过的令牌的模型，这是上下文学习的定义特征。我们将此属性形式化为一组令牌重新标记下数据分布的不变性。考虑有效的标记序列are solved by the same mechanism. A model that depends on this relational structure, rather than on specific token identities, is precisely the kind of model that generalizes to tokens unseen during training, which is a defining feature of in-context learning. We formalize this property as an invariance of the data distribution under a group of token relabelings. However, what counts as an admissible permutation?

我们根据任务强加于底层词汇的关系结构来定义可接受的标记排列。并非每次重新标记都会保留任务：当预测依赖于标记之间的固定关系（例如记忆的关联）时，不尊重这些关系的排列会产生不同的任务。因此，可接受的排列正是保留该结构的排列。 让We define admissible token permutations based on the relational structure that a task imposes on the underlying vocabulary. Not every relabeling preserves the task: when the prediction relies on fixed relations between tokens, such as memorized associations, a permutation that does not respect those relations yields a different task. The admissible permutations are therefore exactly those that preserve this structure. 超越仅注意变压器。Beyond Attention-Only Transformers.

标准 Transformer 还包括前馈网络 (FFN) 和层归一化 (LN)。我们从核心分析中省略了这些组件，以便专注于主要负责归纳能力的注意力层。尽管如此，我们的理论结果自然地扩展到具有 FFN 和 LN 的标准 Transformer，正如我们在Standard Transformers additionally include feed-forward networks (FFN) and layer normalizations (LN). We omit these components from the core analysis in order to focus on attention layers, which are primarily responsible for inductive capabilities. Nevertheless, our theoretical results extend naturally to standard Transformers with FFNs and LNs, as we discuss insection˜A.5.

3.2 选择、写作和行动基础Selection, Writing, and Action Bases

我们的主要结果（Our main result (Theorems˜1和and1下面）指出，当变压器在块列表任务上进行训练时，梯度下降将其键查询和输出权重限制在一小组基础矩阵的范围内。 在本节中，我们构建这些基本矩阵，每个基本矩阵都编码一个可能对解决块列表任务有用的基本动作。我们的建设依赖于三个中间基础：below) states that, when a transformer is trained on a block-list task, gradient descent confines its key–query and output weights to the span of a small set of basis matrices. In this section, we construct these basis matrices, each of which encodes one elementary action that is possibly useful for solving a block-list task. Our construction depends on three intermediate bases:选择矩阵selection matrices是标记或位置的可学习映射（例如，“将每个位置映射到前一个位置”），are learnable mappings of tokens or positions (e.g., “map each position to the previous”),写作基础writing bases跟踪每个头如何将信息写入残留流（以及后续层如何将其读回），以及track how each head writes information into the residual stream (and thus how later layers can read it back), and行动基地action bases跟踪链式注意力头如何改变原始嵌入（将书写基础扩展到多层）。track how chained attention heads transform the original embeddings (extending writing bases to multiple layers).

当选择上下文信息时，注意力头必须比较转换后的查询和关键表示。 在我们的阻止列表任务设置中，可以通过两种方式完成此操作： 代币可以通过其身份直接与其自身进行比较， 或者可以将它们与对称相关的对应物进行比较。 这些操作可以通过两个矩阵表示：When selecting contextual information, an attention head must compare transformed query and key representations. In our block-list task setup, this can be done in two ways: tokens can be compared directly to themselves via their identity, or they can be compared to their symmetry-related counterparts. 最后，每个注意力头可以使用任何以下方式构造键和查询： 累积到该层的表示。这是通过以下方式实现的 在查询的左侧和右侧旋转选择矩阵 键的一侧，对齐所需的子空间。 同样，最终输出 层可以通过从适当的读取来选择任何令牌表示 子空间。因此，我们定义Finally, each attention head may construct keys and queries using any of the representations that have accumulated up to that layer. This is achieved by rotating a selection matrix on the left side for the query and on the right side for the key, aligning the desired subspaces. 证明草图。Proof Sketch.

我们的证明依赖于数据的两个关键对称性，分别涉及令牌嵌入和位置嵌入。首先，标记之间的唯一相关性是关联标记之间的相关性。这意味着数据分布在任何保留共同关联的标记排列下都被保留。其次，块具有随机偏移，以模拟每对连续块之间的任意数量的不相关令牌。这意味着当改变块的位置偏移时，数据分布被保留。 我们应用这两个转换（令牌排列和位置偏移 移位）到模型输入并计算它如何转换隐藏 表示和模型输出。一个关键结果是所有注意力分数都是 对我们的变换完全不变，因此隐藏和输出 转换本质上与我们的输入转换相同（应用 到不同的子空间）。重要的是，通过模型传递排列的令牌相当于排列其输出，这意味着损失对于我们的 任何输入序列的转换。 最后，由于数据分布对于我们的变换来说是不变的，所以预期的 梯度对于相同的变换也必须是不变的。我们计算 梯度在我们的输入变换下是如何变换的，我们 表明在这些变换下任何不变的梯度都必须符合 结构如上所述。我们提供全面的证明Our proof relies on two key symmetries of the data, regarding token embeddings and position embeddings, respectively. First, the only correlations between tokens are those between associated tokens. This means that the data distribution is preserved under any permutation of tokens that preserves common associations. Second, blocks have random offsets to simulate an arbitrary number of irrelevant tokens between each pair of consecutive blocks. This means that the data distribution is preserved when changing the positional offsets of blocks. We apply these two transformations (token permutation and position offset shifts) to the model input and compute how this transforms the hidden representations and model output. A key result is that all attention scores are perfectly invariant to our transformations, hence the hidden and output transformations are essentially identical to our input transformations (applied to different subspaces). Importantly, passing permuted tokens through the model is equivalent to permuting its outputs, which implies that the loss is also invariant to our transformations for any input sequence. Finally, since the data distribution is invariant to our transformations, the expected gradients must also be invariant to the same transformations. We compute exactly how the gradient is transformed under our input transformations and we show that any gradients invariant under those transformations must fit the structure described above. We provide a comprehensive proof insection˜A.3。 ∎. ∎

3.4 推理电路的几何结构The Geometry of Reasoning Circuits

每个基重在Each of the basis weights in𝒲ℓ\mathcal{W}_{\ell}和and𝒲¯\bar{\mathcal{W}}对应于特定嵌入子空间上的简单且可解释的动作。 对于注意力层，这种可解释的动作可能是， 例如，“关注前一个位置”或“关注由头 1 检索到的令牌”，而输出操作可能类似于“读取由头 3 检索到的令牌”。 当模型在 IMIR 上时，通过将其分解为 对应于每个权重矩阵的分量corresponds to a simple and interpretable action over specific subspaces of embeddings. For attention layers, such interpretable actions might be, for example, “attending to the previous position” or “attending to the token retrieved by head 1”, while an output action might be something like “read the token retrieved by head 3”. When the model is on the IMIR, by decomposing it into its components corresponding to each weight matrix in𝒲ℓ\mathcal{W}_{\ell}和and𝒲¯\bar{\mathcal{W}}，我们可以将模型描述为高度可解释的动作的总和。 当模型不在 IMIR 上时，将其投影到 IMIR 上可提供部分描述。 我们对权重空间给出了更全面、更直观的描述, we can describe the model as a sum of highly interpretable actions. When the model is not on the IMIR, projecting it onto the IMIR provides a partial description. We give a more comprehensive and intuitive description of the weight spaces insection˜C.1。 我们还从表征对称性中给出了权重空间的理论动机. We also give a theoretical motivation for the weight spaces from representational symmetries insection˜C.2，讨论为什么他们捕获与归纳任务相关的所有动作。, discussing why they capture all actions relevant for inductive tasks.

4 了解巡回赛Understanding Circuit Competition

4.1 自然语言的数据分布特性Data Distributional Properties of Natural Language

上面没有讨论的一个重要方面是如何对令牌进行采样One important aspect not discussed above is how to sample the tokens𝐱{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{x}}}在任务中使用。 值得注意的是，之前的工作used in the tasks. Notably, prior work[21, 22, 24, 19]已经表明，这种选择可以对语言模型的训练动态产生重大影响，特别是自然语言中标记分布的标准属性（例如 Zipfian 分布或突发性）可以加速学习。 我们将许多自然语言分布属性合并到 我们的设置如下：has shown that this choice can have a strong impact on the training dynamics of language models, and, in particular, that standard properties of token distributions in natural languages (e.g., Zipfian distributions or burstiness) can accelerate learning. We incorporate a number of natural language distributional properties into our setup as follows:

  1. 1.

    令牌的频率不同。Tokens differ in frequency.自然语言中的标记频率通常遵循长尾分布Token frequencies in natural language typically follow a long-tailed distribution[32, 33]。 为了对此进行建模并使我们的设置更接近自然语言（同时保持其易于分析处理），我们考虑词汇表中的标记子集以形成一组. To model this and bring our setup closer to natural language (while keeping it analytically tractable), we consider a subset of the tokens in our vocabulary to form a set of普通代币common tokens 𝒱c{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}^{c}}}总发生概率with total probability of occurrenceℙ​(v∈𝒱c)=1−fr\mathbb{P}(v\in{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}^{c}}})=1-f_{r}哪里wherefr∈[0;1]f_{r}\in[0;1]。 其余的代币称为. The remaining tokens are termed稀有代币rare tokens: 𝒱r=𝒱∖𝒱c{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}^{r}}}={{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}\setminus{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}^{c}}}, 与, withℙ​(v∈𝒱r)=fr\mathbb{P}(v\in{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{V}}}^{r}}})=f_{r}。 我们假设稀有标记形成了一个几乎无限的集合，其中没有稀有标记被观察到两次。. We assume that rare tokens form a virtually infinite set, where no rare token is ever observed twice.777在实践中，我们使用有限词汇和词法变量假设来模拟这样一个几乎“无限”的词汇In practice, we model such a virtually “infinite” vocabulary using a finite vocabulary and a lexinvariant assumption[30]，其中稀有令牌的嵌入在每个批次中都会重复重新采样，从而阻止模型记住它。, where a rare token’s embeddings are repeatedly re-sampled at every batch, inhibiting the model from memorizing it.

  2. 2.

    令牌可能是突发的。Tokens can be bursty.自然语言文档往往多次包含某个概念或关联，或者根本不包含。换句话说，在自然语言中，概念并不是统一出现的，而是以“突发”的形式出现。例如，考虑一下“突发”这个词本身，它在本文中多次出现，而大多数作品根本不包含它。我们通过假设上下文中存在的块对的平均重数为Documents in natural language tend to contain a concept or association multiple times, or not at all. In other words, in natural language, concepts do not show up uniformly, but rather in ‘bursts’. Consider, for example, the word ‘burstiness’ itself, which appears several times in this document, while most works do not contain it at all. We incorporate this behavior in our task class by assuming that block pairs present in the context have an average multiplicity ofb≥1{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}b}}\geq 1。例如，输入序列. For example, an input sequence withb=2{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}b}}=2可能看起来像“might look like "ab,gh,gh,ab,g→h\mathrm{ab,gh,gh,ab,g\rightarrow h}”。我们写". We write𝒟​(b){{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{D}}}({{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}b}})对于突发时产生的数据分布for the resulting data distribution at burstinessb{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}b}}，当我们比较突发级别之间的梯度时，依赖性变得明确。, making the dependence explicit when we compare gradients across burstiness levels.

  3. 3.

    令牌是多义的。Tokens are polysemous.相同的标记在不同的文档中可以呈现不同的含义和关联。 例如，在计算机科学书籍中，“Alan”这个名字通常可能后面跟着“Turing”姓氏，但有时它后面也可能后面跟着一个不同的姓氏，例如“Baker”。The same token can present different meanings and associations in different documents. For example, in computer science books, the name ‘Alan’ might be commonly followed by the surname ‘Turing’, but at times it might also be followed by a different surname such as ‘Baker’.888艾伦·贝克（Alan Baker，1939-2018）是一位英国数学家，以其在数论有效方法（特别是源自超越数论的方法）方面的工作而闻名。Alan Baker (1939–2018) was an English mathematician, known for his work on effective methods in number theory, in particular those arising from transcendental number theory.在我们的设置中，我们通过假设公共标记之后要预测的下一个标记与其与频率的常见关联不同来对此方面进行建模In our setup, we model this aspect by assuming that the next token to be predicted after a common token differs from its common association with frequencyfv∈[0,1]{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}f_{v}}}\in[0,1].

过去的研究表明，情境学习能力在以下情况下表现最佳： 使用许多稀有代币训练的 Transformer，具有高突发性和高 类内变异性Past work has shown that in-context learning abilities emerge optimally in transformers trained with many rare tokens, high burstiness, and high within-class variability[21, 22]。在缺席的情况下 在这些特性中，情境学习是在显着增加之后出现的 培训，或者根本不培训。 相同的属性被证明可以在 3 参数中进行学习 感应头形成的现象学模型. In the absence of these properties, in-context learning emerges after significantly more training, or not at all. The same properties were shown to enable learning in a 3-parameter phenomenological model of induction-head formation[24]。最后，突发性被证明可以加速 单层变压器中稀疏注意力的出现. Finally, burstiness was shown to accelerate the emergence of sparse attention in single-layer transformers[19]。我们举例说明了这些属性. We exemplify these properties infig.˜2.

感应头是一张中奖彩票。The induction head is a winning ticket.

彩票假说（LTH）The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH)[25]假设一个 随机初始化的网络包含一个稀疏子网络，该子网络经过训练 隔离，匹配密集网络的性能。我们的框架确定了 明确这样一个子网络：四参数posits that a randomly initialized network contains a sparse subnetwork which, trained in isolation, matches the dense network’s performance. Our framework identifies one such subnetwork explicitly: the four-parameter(α,β,γ,δ)(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)IMIR 子流形。我们直接通过以下方式测试预测IMIR sub-manifold. We test the prediction directly via约束训练constrained training：在每个 SGD 步骤中，我们将模型投影回 所跨越的子空间: at every SGD step we project the model back onto the subspace spanned byα,β,γ,δ\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta。由此产生的动态 与无约束网络的那些非常匹配（. The resulting dynamics closely match those of the unconstrained network (fig.˜3, 对）。, right).

4.3 初始化的作用：感应头的竞争The Role of Initialization: Competing Induction Heads

感应头可以在不同层中使用任何一对注意力头。 因此，在具有三层且每层一个头的变压器中，在同一任务上进行训练，可以实现三种不同的感应头电路，如图所示An induction head can use any pair of attention heads in different layers. Thus, in a transformer with three layers and one head per layer, trained on the same task, three distinct induction-head circuits are possible, as depicted infig.˜4（右）。 随机初始化的模型必须收敛于其中之一（或它们的组合）。 为了更好地理解初始化如何影响学习电路，我们改变两个参数（表示为(right). A randomly initialized model must converge to one of them (or a composition of them). To better understand how the initialization influences the learned circuit, we vary two parameters (denoted asβ\beta和andβ′′\beta^{\prime\prime}），我们绘制“获胜”电路) and we plot the ‘winning’ circuit infig.˜4（左）。 我们提供完整的培训细节(left). We give the full training details insection˜E.1我们绘制了 12 颗种子的完整训练动态and we plot the full training dynamics for 12 seeds insection˜E.2.

获胜机制很难预测。Winning mechanics are complex to predict.

在 LTH 文献中，获胜子网络通常是通过训练后的权重大小来识别的，而是否可以根据初始化的属性（例如初始权重大小）来预测它们仍然存在争议。In the LTH literature, winning subnetworks are typically identified by weight magnitude after training, and whether they can instead be predicted from properties of the initialization—such as initial weight magnitude—remains actively debated[34, 35, 36]。 我们的设置中最简单的基于初始化的预测器是，当每个电路自己的单元开始很大时，它就会获胜。 我们可以通过查看来分析这个预测变量. The simplest initialization-based predictor in our setup would be that each circuit wins when its own units start large. 电路战斗的故事。The story of a circuit battle.

仔细观察相变A closer look at the phase transitions infig.˜4（左）也揭示了我们的 Transformer 的学习动态。 首先，请注意，蓝色和绿色溶液之间以及蓝色和红色之间的这些相变非常急剧，但绿色和红色之间则不然。 这是因为红色和绿色电路是协作的：两者共享(left) also sheds light on our transformer’s learning dynamics. First, note that these phase transitions are very sharp between the blue and green solutions and between blue and red, but not between green and red. This is because the red and green circuits are cooperative: both shareα\alpha，同时, whileβ\beta和andβ′\beta^{\prime}位于不同的层中。与此同时，蓝色正在与红色和绿色竞争，试图以不同的方式使用相同的图层。这也可以解释为什么红色需要大are in different layers. Meanwhile, blue is competing with both red and green, trying to use the same layers in different ways. This might also explain why red requires a largeβ′′\beta^{\prime\prime}：它刺激蓝色电路，进而抑制绿色电路。 值得注意的是，学习动态图: it stimulates the blue circuit, which in turn inhibits the green circuit. Notably, the learning dynamics plots insection˜E.2似乎支持这一分析。appear to support this analysis.

5 用于感应任务的自动电路检测Automated Circuit Detection for Induction Tasks

我们的理论框架提供了两个好处，可以改善训练模型中的电路发现。 首先，与完整参数空间相比，IMIR 具有较低的维数，这大大减少了电路搜索空间。 其次，虽然大多数可解释性工作都在注意力头水平上识别回路Our theoretical framework offers two benefits that may improve circuit discovery in trained models. First, the IMIR has a low dimensionality compared to the full parameter space, which greatly reduces the circuit search space. Second, while most interpretability works identify circuits at the level of attention heads[37, 3, 4, 38]，IMIR 使我们能够在更精细的重量结构级别上识别电路，使我们能够了解每个磁头的确切机制。, the IMIR allows us to identify circuits at the more granular level of precise weight structures, enabling us to understand the exact mechanism of each head.101010我们的 IMIR 中的碱基也类似于 D-RASP 反编译过程产生的变量The bases present in our IMIR are also similar to the variables produced by the D-RASP decompilation procedure inFriedman et al. [31], Weiss et al. [39].

为了说明这些好处，我们将我们的框架应用于以下问题： 自动电路发现To illustrate these benefits, we apply our framework to the question of Automated Circuit Discovery[4]感应电路。我们 在两跳感应上训练仅深度注意力的单头变压器 任务of induction circuits. We train deep attention-only single-head transformers on the two-hop induction task[10]（培训详情在(training details insection˜F.1）。我们使用一个简单的方法发现学习电路 算法：我们将学习到的参数投影到 IMIR 中，并消除 不影响性能的尺寸。我们描绘了恢复的电路 示意性地在). We discover the learned circuit using a simple algorithm: we project the learned parameters to the IMIR and we ablate the dimensions that don’t impact performance. We depict the recovered circuits schematically infig.˜5。我们在中描述了完整的算法. We describe the complete algorithm insection˜F.2和完整的电路and the complete circuits insection˜F.3.

一个有趣的发现是，图中描述的注意力路径One interesting finding is that the attention paths depicted infig.˜5不能仅使用最少的必要集合来实现 方向，但也利用一些额外的“辅助”方向。的 额外的方向通过减少 注意不相关的标记。这种结构对于人来说是不可见的 现有的自动电路发现算法的粒度为 注意头部水平。are not implemented using only a minimal set of necessary directions, but also leverage a few additional ‘aiding’ directions. The additional directions marginally increase the accuracy by reducing the attention to irrelevant tokens. This kind of structure would be invisible to existing automated circuit discovery algorithms with granularity at the attention head level.

6 结论和未来的工作Conclusion and Future Work

在本文中，我们为一类在块列表任务上训练的变压器确定了不变流形。 这个流形使我们能够研究 Transformer 的训练动态，并将训练模型的权重分解为可解释的子空间。 我们现在讨论未来工作的三个方向 除了本文中演示的用例之外，理论框架可能也有用。In this paper, we identified an invariant manifold for a class of transformers trained on block-list tasks. This manifold allows us to both study transformers’ training dynamics, and to decompose trained models’ weights into interpretable subspaces. We now discuss three directions for future work in which our theoretical framework might prove useful in addition to the use cases demonstrated in this paper.

提高推理能力。Improving Reasoning Abilities.

机械可解释性已被证明对于改进神经网络架构的设计非常有用Mechanistic interpretability has already proven useful for the design of improved neural network architectures[40, 41, 42, 12]。 例如，选择机制. For example, the selection mechanism in曼巴Mamba架构architectures[43]灵感来自感应头is inspired by induction heads[26]。 因此，更好地理解归纳推理能力（及其出现）可能有助于开发改进的学习算法。 特别是，我们的理论框架提供了一大类感应电路的几何描述。 可以更有效地识别和修剪无用的电路，同时可以使用更少数量的参数来描述剩余电路，从而减少内存占用和推理延迟。 此外，众所周知，在长序列中学习感应头会更加困难. A better understanding of inductive reasoning abilities (and their emergence) may thus enable the development of improved learning algorithms. In particular, our theoretical framework provides a geometric description of a large class of induction circuits. Useless circuits can be identified and pruned more effectively, while remaining circuits can be described using a reduced number of parameters, reducing the memory footprint and inference latency. Moreover, it is known that learning induction heads is more difficult in long sequences[20]，而深度电路需要隐式课程或指数量的数据, while deep circuits require either an implicit curriculum or an exponential amount of data[11, 44]。 我们可以设计没有这些限制的神经架构吗？. Can we design neural architectures without these limitations?

加速大规模实验。Accelerating Experiments at Scale.

在深度学习中，很多重要的现象，比如ICL的数据依赖In deep learning, many important phenomena, such as data dependency of ICL[21]或超越过度拟合的泛化or generalization beyond overfitting[45]，开始于综合任务中的经验观察， 在后来证明它们在一般设置中保持不变之前, began as empirical observations in synthetic tasks, before they were later shown to hold in general settings[22, 46]。原因很简单： 在完整数据集上训练大型模型既缓慢又昂贵，而发现 新现象可能需要快速进行大量实验。 我们的 框架可以通过两种方式进一步加速实验。首先，由 将学习限制为 IMIR，甚至是兴趣的缩减子集 尺寸，训练可以大大优化，减少实验时间和 计算需求。其次，通过提供几何描述 有意义的方向，我们的框架可以帮助假设生成和 了解训练动态。. There is a simple reason for this: training large models on full datasets is slow and costly, whereas uncovering novel phenomena may require running a great number of experiments quickly. Our framework can further accelerate experimentation in two ways. First, by constraining learning to the IMIR, or even a reduced subset of interesting dimensions, training can be greatly optimized, reducing experiment time and computational demands. Second, by providing the geometric description of meaningful directions, our framework can aid hypothesis generation and understanding of training dynamics.

其他任务中的不变流形。Invariant Manifolds in Other Tasks.

在这项工作中，我们展示了如何使用不变流形来理解 训练动态和模型内部结构。虽然学习流形不变 动力学之前已经研究过In this work, we have shown how invariant manifolds can be used to understand training dynamics and model internals. While invariant manifolds of learning dynamics have been studied before[47, 48, 20]，据我们所知，这 工作首先确定了不变流形的几何形状 负责学习一大类任务。如果归纳任务表现出 低维不变流形，那么也许其他任务也可以。揭秘 它们可以帮助我们更好地理解深度神经网络中的学习动态 网络。, to the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to identify the geometry of the invariant manifolds responsible for learning a large class of tasks. If inductive tasks exhibit a low-dimensional invariant manifold, then maybe other tasks also do. Uncovering them could lead to a better understanding of learning dynamics in deep neural networks.

A.3.5 向后传递Backward Pass

(37)

证明的一个关键因素是注意力分数对于我们的注意力分数是不变的 输入转换：保留关联的排列不会影响 令牌与其自身或其关联令牌之间的注意力，它们是 仅允许令牌操作；同样，不同位置之间的注意力 不受全局偏移量变化的影响。由于注意力分数是 对于我们的变换来说是不变的，它们的梯度也是不变的。对于 层数A key ingredient of the proof is that attention scores are invariant to our input transformations: association-preserving permutations don’t affect the attention between a token and itself or its associated token, which are the only allowed token actions; likewise, the attention between different positions is not affected by a global offset change. Since the attention scores are invariant to our transformations, their gradients are also invariant. 人口梯度。Population Gradients.

我们现在注意到，由于我们的转换（通过构造）保留了输入输出对的可能性，因此它们会产生相同的数据分布。 由于损失在变换下也被保留，这意味着总体梯度对于我们的变换是不变的：We now note that, since our transformations (by construction) preserve the likelihood of the input–output pairs, they result in an identical data distribution. As the loss is also preserved under transformation, this implies that the population gradient is invariant to our transformations:

A.3.6 渐变块Gradient Blocks

最后，在本节中，我们得出结论，证明我们的模型的梯度将存在于构造的流形内。 为此，我们首先分析哪些矩阵对于所研究的变换是不变的。 我们不是直接分析梯度，而是将其分解为由概念对（标记或位置）和层子集对索引的块，即通过网络中可能的交互路径。 这种分解很方便，因为每个块更容易单独处理，并且所有块都遵循相同的对称性参数。 此外，它不会丢失任何内容：残差流激活完全在概念子空间及其在复合值图下的图像上得到支持，因此下面未考虑的任何梯度块为零，因为相应的激活为零。Finally, in this section we conclude our proof that our model’s gradient will live inside the constructed manifold. To that end, we first analyze which matrices are invariant with respect to the studied transformations. Rather than analyzing the gradient directly, we decompose it into blocks indexed by pairs of concepts (tokens or positions) and pairs of layer subsets, i.e., by the possible interaction paths through the network. This decomposition is convenient because each block is easier to treat in isolation, and all blocks follow the same symmetry argument. Moreover, it loses nothing: the residual-stream activations are supported entirely on the concept subspaces and their images under the composite value maps, so any gradient block not considered below is zero, since the corresponding activations are zero.

A.5 超越仅注意：前馈网络和层规范Beyond Attention Only: Feed-Forward Networks & Layer Norm

把它放在一起。Putting it together.

在本附录中，我们讨论不变流形的几何 归纳推理 (IMIR) 更详细。我们首先给出一个直观的 对其坐标系的描述，然后给出理论动机 其起源基于表征对称性。In this appendix, we discuss the geometry of the Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning (IMIR) in more detail. We first give an intuitive description of its coordinate frame, and then we give a theoretical motivation for its origin based on representational symmetries.

C.1 什么是注意力头？What is an Attention Head?

现在我们的关键理论结果已经确立，我们给出一个直观的 其几何形状的描述。使用玩具注意力示例，我们介绍 电感不变流形中存在的电路机制 推理。考虑输入嵌入Now that our key theoretical result has been established, we give an intuitive description of its geometry. Using a toy attention example, we introduce the mechanisms of the circuits that exist in the Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning. What can an attention head do with this input?

令牌操作。Token Actions.

在我们的设置中，我们认为数据中存在的唯一相关性是 在非重叠的关联标记对之间In our setup, we consider that the only correlations present in the data are between non-overlapping pairs of associated tokens inℛ{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{R}}}，正如形式化的, as formalized by theℛ{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathcal{R}}}- 不变性假设-invariance assumption ofsection˜A.1。 因此，对于每个标记，模型只能学习两种可能的映射： 相同的令牌或关联的令牌。将其应用于注意力头，我们得到 两个可能的令牌操作。首先，注意力头可能会寻找确切的 它具有的标记，构建在输入时对齐的键和查询向量 令牌匹配，即. Thus, for each token, the model can learn only two possible mappings: to the same token or to the associated token. Applying this to attention heads, we get two possible token actions. First, an attention head may look for the exact token it has, constructing key and query vectors that align when the input tokens match, i.e.𝐖K(1,1)​𝐞𝐚≈𝐖Q(1,1)​𝐞𝐛{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{W}^{(1,1)}_{K}}}\,{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{e}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{a}}}}}}\approx{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{W}^{(1,1)}_{Q}}}\,{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{e}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{b}}}}}}当when𝐚=𝐛{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{a}}}={{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}\mathbf{b}}}。这是通过 key-query 实现的 电路大约是恒等变换的倍数 令牌嵌入的子空间，即. 职位行动。Position Actions.

在我们的设置中，每个块都有一个随机位置偏移，模拟 分隔连续块的任意（未知）数量的虚构标记。 这打破了不同块之间的位置相关性，这意味着 位置嵌入只能用于处理之前的位置 同一块（最多In our setup, each block has a random positional offset, simulating an arbitrary (unknown) number of imaginary tokens separating consecutive blocks. This breaks positional correlations between separate blocks, which means that positional embeddings may only be used to attend to a previous position in the same block (up tok−1{{\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{0,0,0}\pgfsys@color@gray@stroke{0}\pgfsys@color@gray@fill{0}k}}-1位置靠后）。事实上，由于块偏移是独立采样的，所以不同块的令牌之间的相对位置是均匀随机的并且不携带任何可用信息。 这是通过构造按一定位置距离对齐的键向量和查询向量来实现的，即positions back). Indeed, since block offsets are sampled independently, the relative position between tokens of different blocks is uniformly random and carries no usable information. D.4 证明Proof ofTheorem˜2

我们给出了详细的证明We give the detailed proof ofTheorem˜2，根据证明 草图：我们将数据分布划分为 IWL 所在的部分 解决方案成功，其余部分成功，我们表明 IWL 解决方案杀死了 前者的 ICL 梯度不变，而后者的 ICL 梯度保持不变。, following the proof sketch: we partition the data distribution into the part on which the IWL solution succeeds and the remainder, and we show that the IWL solution kills the ICL gradient on the former while leaving it unchanged on the latter.

F.2 电路检测算法Circuit Detection Algorithm

我们的电路检测例程对 训练模型的流形坐标。从全套IMIR开始 方向，它重复下降消融增加的单个方向 损失最小，并且即使是最便宜的消融术也能停止 将固定评估批次的损失推至用户提供的预算之上Our circuit-detection routine performs greedy backward elimination on the manifold coordinates of the trained model. Starting from the full set of IMIR directions, it repeatedly drops the single direction whose ablation increases the loss the least, and stops when even the cheapest available ablation would push the loss on a fixed evaluation batch above a user-supplied budgetτ\tau。 幸存的方向，按每电路消融成本排序，是 算法识别模型的基本电路。. The surviving directions, sorted by their per-circuit ablation cost, are the algorithm’s identification of the model’s essential circuits.

自由消融松弛The free-ablation slackρ\rho一个小优化：一次内扫描 找到成本在一个因素内的消融is a small optimization: once the inner scan finds an ablation whose cost is within a factorρ\rho对于当前的损失，我们 接受它而不完成回合。这使得每一轮都保持在of the current loss, we accept it without finishing the round. This keeps each round atO​(|𝒜|)O(|\mathcal{A}|)在最坏的情况下，但通常会便宜得多 方向显然是可修剪的。随机扫描顺序避免了偏差 总是首先探测相同的前缀。固定评价批次in the worst case but typically much cheaper when several directions are obviously prunable. The randomized scan order avoids the bias of always probing the same prefix first. The fixed evaluation batchℬ\mathcal{B}嵌入层使用的确定性 RNG 种子确保两个 同一模型的评估会产生相同的损失，这是 贪婪的比较才有意义。我们使用这些值and the deterministic RNG seed used by the embedding layer ensure that two evaluations of the same model produce identical losses, which is required for the greedy comparisons to be meaningful. We use the valuesτ=100\tau=100和andρ=1.01\rho=1.01在我们的实验中。in our experiments.

F.3 发现的电路Discovered Circuits

我们运行贪婪的向后消除程序We run the greedy backward-elimination procedure ofAlgorithm˜1上 两个经过训练的 5 层变压器解决了on two trained 5-layer transformers solving thek=2k=2跳跃诱导任务，以及 报告发现的电路hop induction task, and report the discovered circuits intables˜2和and3。除了这四个 人们期望从规范的感应头结构中得到的单位——a 前一个令牌头，两个通过值旋转链接的项目匹配头，以及 反转链的读数——算法始终如一地恢复 少数. In addition to the four units one would expect from a canonical induction-head construction — a previous-token head, two item-match heads chained through value rotations, and a readout that inverts the chain — the algorithm consistently recovers a small number of帮助aiding单位，进一步提高精度，而不是 任何标准归纳模板的一部分。我们将两组分开 为清楚起见，列出了表格。units that further lift accuracy without being part of any standard induction template. We separate the two groups in the tables for clarity.

援助单位本身就很有趣：移除它们会降低孤立的单位 子电路的精度The aiding units are interesting on their own: removing them drops the isolated subcircuit’s accuracy from∼0.92\sim 0.92下降到down to∼0.6\sim 0.6 (table˜2, 0.922→0.5940.922\to 0.594），这不仅仅是 稍微细化。它们似乎与规范归纳单元组合在一起 形成一个稍微冗余的整体，利用多条路径 同时剩余流。这种结构对于人来说是不可见的 现有的自动电路发现算法的粒度为 注意头部水平。我们在下面列出了四个规范单位), which is much more than a slight refinement. They appear to compose with the canonical induction units to form a slightly redundant ensemble that exploits multiple paths through the residual stream simultaneously. This kind of structure would be invisible to existing automated circuit discovery algorithms with granularity at the attention head level.
